BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, tᵉrûwmîyâh means a sacrificial offering. In Ezekiel 48:12, this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy.
TheologicalSignificance: An offering set apart as most holy makes me want to give God my best, not whatever is left over.
